d: Barney leads the children in new dances races and dramatic play encouraging creativity movement and imaginative exploration.
Using their imaginations the children design and build a pretend airplane learning about invention teamwork and make-believe.
A picture sparks Barney and the children to imagine exploring a tropical island filled with pretend adventures and discoveries.
Barney encourages the children to appreciate what makes each of them special unique and important in their own way.
Barney teaches the children what to expect when a new baby arrives and helps them understand the changes that happen in families.
The children explore different trucks and learn about sharing playing safely and respecting others while using big vehicles.
Inspired by construction vehicles the children work as a team to build a pretend castle and learn cooperation and teamwork.
Barney teaches the importance of exercising eating well and practicing healthy habits to stay strong active and happy.
BJ leads the kids in a day of ball games teaching coordination teamwork sharing and staying active through fun sports play.
Barney leads the children on a number hunt helping them discover numbers everywhere in their daily world and activities.

st: A Wonderful World of Colors and Shapes
d: An art show helps the children explore shapes colors creativity and artistic expression through fun and hands-on learning.
Barney and the children help Baby Bop learn to spell her name using music games practice and lots of encouragement.
